purpose: unapproved local one-plane research draft for physician validation

selection.ranking: maximum number of labels with an interior v1/v2 agreement component meeting area; nearest middle; lower index tie

ensemble: equal arithmetic mean of original-grid v1/v2 softmax probabilities

refinement.method: checkerboard ICM of fixed 4-neighbour HU-edge-weighted Potts energy

parameter_selection: fixed before viewing the refined mask; no GT or appearance-based tuning
intensity_adapter: existing admitted HU+1024 exploratory adapter; unchanged frozen model preprocessing
scope: only the selected original axial slice; every other plane is unannotated
